name: Jennifer Crawford
source:
Captain / Helicopter Pilot
Nationality: US

A loud-mouthed, hot-headed helicopter pilot. Despite her rather tomboyish, acid-tongued disposition, she is actually a caring and sensitive person. Likes to tease people, sometimes a bit too much. Usually seen fighting with Cecile.
